blocks.text: Theater actress Shiela Valderrama will play Intergalactic Queen Femina Suarestellar Baroux in the 20th-anniversary staging of the Filipino musical “Zsazsa Zaturnnah Ze Parteeeh!” in April 2027. Queen Femina, the ruler of Planet XXX and leader of the Amazonistas, is one of the musical’s central antagonists, known for her flamboyant personality. Composer, lyricist and musical director Vincent A. DeJesus said Valderrama’s musical theater experience makes her a fitting choice for the role. “Ang Zsazsa Zaturnnah ay isang hyper camp universe, at si Queen Femina ay larger than life!
